source_line: HubSpot portal 4451852 · CRM contacts + Marketing Email Analytics API
intro_html: Built directly from HubSpot's CRM API and marketing-email analytics, contact-level lifecycle stages, workflow enrollment lists, and per-email send data, as an independent read alongside Tim's own workflow-reporting build. Enrollment, lifecycle movement, audience and email performance were all pulled on Nov 24, 2026. Movement is measured from each contact's own enrollment date. The program went live Aug 18 per the Asana launch milestone, and most contacts enrolled in bulk runs from Aug 31.

lifecycle.note_html: Contacts enrolled in a Fall 2026 nurture workflow whose lifecyclestage advanced (entered MQL, SQL, Opportunity or Customer) after the day they enrolled. Enrollment comes from each workflow's history (an ever-enrolled list per workflow), not from the nurture_track tag, which is written only when a contact completes the full workflow. Stage entries on the enrollment day itself cannot be ordered against the enrollment and are not counted.

tiles.label: Enrolled contacts moved to a new lifecycle stage after they enrolled
tiles.cap: 44 in Inquiry Journeys, 29 in Inkwell and 1 in Great First Eight, out of 7,271 enrollments across the four workflows with contacts. Agnostic has none yet. 66 are MQL entries; the other 8 entered SQL, Opportunity or Customer only. 8 reached Customer: 4 in Inkwell at the same school (likely a sales close) and 4 in Inquiry Journeys at four different schools.

tiles.label: Contacts enrolled across the four workflows
tiles.cap: 6,321 in progress and 950 no longer active (removed by a suppression list or completed). Inquiry Journeys 3,462, Inkwell 2,177, Agnostic 1,451, Great First Eight 181. World History has none. The large majority of Inquiry Journeys enrolled in one bulk run on Aug 31.

tiles.label: Of both Inquiry Journeys and Inkwell contacts moved after enrolling, about the same
tiles.cap: 44 of 3,462 in Inquiry Journeys and 29 of 2,177 in Inkwell, both about 1.3%; 1 of 181 in Great First Eight (0.6%). Most of the Aug 31 bulk run has now had twelve weeks. Most October and November enrollees have had far less time, so these rates will keep rising.

tiles.label: Enrolled contacts had already entered a lifecycle stage before they enrolled
tiles.cap: 168 in Inquiry Journeys and 332 in Inkwell entered MQL or a later stage between Aug 6 and their enrollment, plus 11 in Great First Eight and 5 in Agnostic. Another 82 did so on the enrollment day itself. For these contacts the content conversion that made them MQL is likely also what enrolled them, so reaching MQL cannot be counted as a nurture result. MQL to SQL is a cleaner test of the nurture.

by_program.moved_note: 44 after the enrollment day: 40 entered MQL, plus 4 whose only new stage was SQL, Opportunity or Customer. 4 reached Customer, at four different schools. 4 enrolled contacts have no enrollment date yet.

29 after the enrollment day: 25 entered MQL and 4 entered Customer only. 4 total reached Customer, all contacts at the same school who became customers on Aug 31, likely a sales close. 29 enrolled contacts have no enrollment date yet.
1 after the enrollment day: entered MQL. 11 contacts entered a stage before they enrolled, and 1 did so on the enrollment day itself.
No stage entries after the enrollment day. 5 contacts entered a stage before they enrolled. 1 enrolled contact has no enrollment date yet.
No contacts enrolled and no emails sent. Cause unconfirmed: the enrollment audience may be empty or the workflow may be off.

coverage.title: What is and is not counted
coverage.html: Enrollment counts come from lists that read each workflow's status, so every program is covered, including Great First Eight and Agnostic, which the nurture_track tag never captured. Two limits. 34 contacts (Inquiry Journeys 4, Inkwell 29, Agnostic 1) have no Nurture Enrollment Date yet, so they are counted as enrolled but cannot be counted as moved. Stage at enrollment is starting to fill in: 1,146 contacts account wide now carry a Nurture Stage at Enrollment value, but only 8 of this week's 74 movers are among them, too few yet to split movement by starting stage.

portfolio.note_html: Delivery grew again this week (23,967 to 24,934), driven mainly by Inkwell's Knowledge-building module 5 on both tracks, which jumped from a combined 363 to 782 delivered (135 to 386 on Classroom, 228 to 396 on Leadership) as it scaled toward full volume. Agnostic's suppression problem has worsened again: the program now suppresses 325% of what it delivers, up from 300% last week, with module 4 now the worst offender (696 suppressed against 161 delivered, nearly 4.3x). That is worth checking before reading anything else into Agnostic's numbers.

tiles.label: Total delivered across the portfolio, up from 23,967 on Nov 17
tiles.cap: IJ 14,506 · Inkwell 8,630 · GF8 595 · Agnostic 1,203 · World History 0. Inquiry Journeys alone is 58% of all delivery.

tiles.label: Unique open rate portfolio-wide, bots excluded
tiles.cap: 7,050 unique opens on 24,934 delivered. By program: Inquiry Journeys 29.8%, Inkwell 26.3%, GF8 22.9%, Agnostic 26.7%. Click rate is 1.6% and unsubscribe 0.4%, inside the under-1% guardrail portfolio wide.

tiles.label: Nurture emails that have sent at all
tiles.cap: 9 of the 49 registered emails have no real volume yet: all 4 World History emails, Inquiry Journeys modules 8 on Classroom and Leadership plus a duplicate Leadership module 7 test record, and Inkwell module 8 on both tracks. The newest modules are still below the 20-delivered floor.

tiles.label: Agnostic suppression rate against delivered, the worst in the portfolio
tiles.cap: 3,910 suppressed against 1,203 delivered program wide. Module 4 alone suppresses nearly 4.3x what it delivers, 696 suppressed against 161 delivered, with module 3 close behind. Worth checking that track's suppression lists and frequency caps immediately. The cause is not confirmable through the API.

workflows_note_html: Confirmed by Kelsey as the only workflows currently nurturing contacts this fall; everything else in the portal's nurture history is retired. HubSpot's Automation/Workflow objects aren't exposed through the connected API, so enabled/paused state and branch logic still need a manual check in HubSpot, the performance on each card comes from the flow's marketing emails instead.

programs.label: Inquiry Journeys
programs.note_html: Classroom has reached seven full-volume modules (1,375, 1,335, 1,266, 1,014, 932, 903 and 782 delivered) and Leadership has reached seven as well (1,219, 1,182, 1,158, 949, 865, 818 and 688 delivered), with module 8 on both tracks and the duplicate Leadership module 7 test record still below the volume floor. Open rate holds from the high twenties to the low forties across modules, peaking at 41.0% on Classroom module 7, the highest single open rate in the portfolio this week. This program carries 58% of portfolio delivery and has 3,462 enrolled contacts, of whom 44 moved to a new lifecycle stage after enrolling (1.3%), unchanged from last week; 4 reached Customer this week, up from 3, at four different schools. The large majority enrolled in one bulk run on Aug 31, so that cohort is now twelve weeks old and the October and November enrollees much younger.

programs.label: Inkwell
programs.note_html: Still the lowest suppression rate in the portfolio by a wide margin (4.2% of delivered, against 34.5% portfolio wide). Classroom module 5 and Leadership module 5 both scaled up sharply this week (135 to 386 and 228 to 396 delivered), the biggest driver of the program's growth. Leadership module 1 remains Inkwell's strongest single open-rate result at 35.9% (355 of 990), just ahead of Leadership module 2's 33.5% (318 of 950); its best click rate shifted to Classroom module 6 this week (2.3% of 128 delivered). Program-wide unsubscribe holds at 0.48%, under the 1% guardrail. Of 2,177 enrolled contacts, 29 moved to a new lifecycle stage after enrolling (1.3%); 4 of those are contacts at the same school who became customers on Aug 31, likely a sales close.

programs.label: Great First Eight
programs.note_html: Every registered Great First Eight email continues sending at real volume for a fourth week: module 6 holds near flat at 64 delivered (up from 60), with module 1 still carrying the most volume at 145 delivered. Clicks remain thin across the program (5 total), so no reliable click read is possible yet. Unsubscribe holds just over the 1% guardrail at 1.34% (8 of 595), with module 1 continuing to carry half of them (4 of 8). 181 contacts are enrolled; 1 moved to a new lifecycle stage after enrolling, unchanged from last week, reaching MQL only.

programs.label: Agnostic
programs.note_html: Suppression keeps worsening across the whole program: 3,910 suppressed against 1,203 delivered program wide, suppressing 325% of what it delivers, up from 300% last week. Module 4 now suppresses the most relative to its own delivery (696 suppressed against 161 delivered, about 4.3x), with module 3 close behind (763 suppressed against 181 delivered, about 4.2x). Open rate is 26.7% program wide, up from 25.1%; module 6, now at 79 delivered, remains the strongest performer at 39.2% (31 of 79), though its volume stays thin. No contacts moved to a new lifecycle stage after enrolling this week, unchanged since launch. Worth checking the suppression lists and frequency caps on this track immediately; the cause is not confirmable from the API.

programs.label: World History
programs.note_html: Unchanged across every check since Aug 31. All four World History emails exist and carry the correct nurture property, but none has ever sent. Two possible causes, neither confirmable through the API: the enrollment audience is empty, or the workflow is not switched on. No contacts are enrolled (its ever-enrolled list is empty), so it shows no movement. The nurture_track__world_history property does not exist, but the enrollment and exit lists read workflow status and do not need it.

emails.note_html: Click-to-open rate (clicks ÷ opens, excluding bots) directly from HubSpot's marketing-email analytics, a purer read on content quality than open rate, since it isolates people who opened and then found something worth clicking. Listed: emails with real volume (20+ delivered as of the last pull); everything thinner is too early to rank. CT = Classroom Track (teacher-facing), LT = Leadership Track (admin-facing).
emails.callout_html: Inkwell's Classroom Track emails continue to convert opens to clicks better than its Leadership Track (6.4% average CTOR across seven CT emails vs. 4.7% across seven LT emails, about 1.4x). Inquiry Journeys's Classroom and Leadership tracks remain about even this week (5.3% CT vs. 5.3% LT).

audience.role_note_html: Split by the contact's Role property for everyone ever enrolled in each workflow. "Admin/Leadership" groups School Leader, District Leader, and Coach/Specialist; "Other/Unassigned" is everyone without a classified role. Inquiry Journeys and Inkwell are mostly administrators and coaches, Great First Eight is mostly teachers, and Agnostic is almost entirely unclassified.
audience.source_note_html: Original source (first-touch attribution) for everyone ever enrolled in each workflow.

movement.html: Contacts enrolled in more than one workflow, counted from the four workflow history exports on Oct 13 (Inquiry Journeys and Inkwell share 92 of them). Cross-product re-routing is expected, so these contacts appear in more than one program above. This count is carried forward until a fresh set of history exports is supplied.

open_items.html: Inquiry Journeys and Inkwell continue moving contacts after enrollment at about the same rate. 44 of Inquiry Journeys's 3,462 enrolled contacts (1.3%) and 29 of Inkwell's 2,177 (1.3%) moved to a new lifecycle stage after enrolling; Great First Eight has 1 of 181. This is not an email-performance problem: open and click rates are healthy. The open question is whether the content is moving contacts who were not already MQL.

Agnostic now suppresses more than three times what it delivers, and the gap is widening. Program wide, 3,910 suppressed against 1,203 delivered (325%, against 34.5% portfolio-wide), up from 300% last week. Module 4 now suppresses the most relative to its own delivery (696 suppressed, 161 delivered, about 4.3x), with module 3 close behind. Worth checking that track's suppression lists and frequency caps immediately. The cause cannot be confirmed through the API.

Inkwell's Knowledge-building module 5 scaled sharply this week on both tracks (135 to 386 delivered on Classroom, 228 to 396 on Leadership), the biggest driver of this week's portfolio delivery growth, from 23,967 to 24,934.

World History has still never sent an email, unchanged since Aug 31: 0 delivered across all 4 emails and 0 contacts enrolled. Either the enrollment audience is empty or the workflow is not live, and neither is readable via API. The missing nurture_track__world_history property no longer blocks tracking, because the lists read workflow status.

The new enrollment fields are filling in slowly. 34 contacts (Inquiry Journeys 4, Inkwell 29, Agnostic 1) still have no enrollment date, and Nurture Stage at Enrollment has started populating for recent enrollees (1,146 contacts account wide) but covers only 8 of this week's 74 movers, too few yet to split movement by starting stage. A fresh set of workflow history exports would also fill in the no-date contacts.

Tim's reporting-structure rebuild is still open and is now the binding constraint. It was due Aug 17 and is fourteen weeks overdue in Asana as of Nov 24. This page is a workaround built from raw API pulls; the Tier 1/2/3 reporting it is standing in for is what the Dec 18 program end and Jan 11 postmortem are supposed to read from.
Confirm enabled/paused state and branch logic for all 5 flows directly in HubSpot. Still not readable via API.

Query note for the next refresh: the role property stores internal values (teacher, school leader, district leader) that differ from its display labels, and the nurture_track* tag is written only when a workflow completes, so it is not used for counting. Count enrollment from the ever-enrolled and active lists listed in the workflow registry.

footnote_html: Source: HubSpot portal 4451852. CRM contact query API (lifecyclestage v2 stage-entry dates and the Nurture Enrollment Date property, read through each workflow's ever-enrolled and active lists, pulled Nov 24, 2026) and Marketing Email Analytics API (OVERVIEW, per-email, bots excluded, pulled Nov 24, 2026), scoped to the 5 confirmed Fall 2026 nurture programs via the nurture property on MARKETING_EMAIL. Lifecycle movement is measured from each contact's own enrollment date (the stage entry must fall after the enrollment day). Email window Jul 30 to Nov 24, 2026. Enrolled counts include contacts who have since been removed or completed. Workflow enabled/paused state is not available via API.
